what: The filer's own figures, as tagged in XBRL and served by the SEC, trimmed to the dates this filing's statements are as of. Ground truth for tools/check_against_filer.py.
note: The ARS for fiscal 2025. Its balance sheet on page 56 is as of 2025-12-31 and 2024-12-31; the income statement on page 57 spans three years.
caveat: companyfacts serves the dimensionless facts. A figure tagged only against a segment, a product or a class is in the filing's own XBRL and not here, so a figure absent from this file is not necessarily a reader error - it is a figure this comparison cannot speak about.
